scope: Finite p1009 coset-shape census for B=4,6,7,8 and the explicit independent uniform rejection model; no solver-cost inference
statement: On the fixed p1009 degree-five horizontal edge, every fully liftable multiplicative x-coset in the tested sizes B=4,6,7,8 has a two-term source vanishing polynomial and a dense endpoint polynomial; attaching APS labels to a preselected point base by independent uniform rejection sampling takes r/M draws in expectation per hit.
